examples.english: The light in the living room is not working.
examples.transliteration: el noor fi el sala mish shaghghal

examples.arabic: عمر رد صباح النور وهو كان متحمس جدا
examples.english: Omar replied morning of light and he was very excited.
examples.transliteration: Omar rad sabaḥ an-noor wa howa kan motahames gedan

examples.arabic: عمر رد بسرعة صباح النور السلام عليكم
examples.english: Omar replied quickly morning of light peace be upon you
examples.transliteration: Omar rad besoraa sabah an noor as salamu alaykum

examples.arabic: سلمى ردت عليها وقالت مساء النور إزيكِ عاملة إيه
examples.english: Salma replied to her and said, "Evening of light! How are you, what's up?"
examples.transliteration: Salma raddet aleiha w qalet masa' an-noor izzayyik amla eh

examples.arabic: مساء النور يا حبيبتي احنا رايحين نشتري هدوم جديدة
examples.english: Evening of light my dear, we are going to buy new clothes.
examples.transliteration: Masa' an-noor ya habibty, ehna rayhin neshtari hedoum gedida.

examples.arabic: صباح الخير يا احمد صباح النور يا بابا
examples.english: Good morning, Ahmed. Morning of light, Dad.
examples.transliteration: Sabaḥ el-kheer ya Ahmed. Sabaḥ an-noor ya Baba.
